title: Enterprise usage exports and dashboard intake: prioritize customer-driven Console requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Multiple enterprise customers (security & finance teams) have requested richer usage analytics, CSV/Parquet export for billing reconciliation, and a customizable per-team cost breakdown dashboard in the Redwood Console. This ticket captures intake notes, proposed prioritization, and next steps for an MVP that addresses immediate enterprise needs while keeping product trade-offs minimal.

Background: Since Q4 2025 we've observed a 30% increase in export/analytics-related support tickets from accounts on Dedicated and Private deployments. Customers need: 1) scheduled exports of token-level usage per API key; 2) per-model and per-route cost breakdowns grouped by org/team; 3) an embeddable dashboard or CSV export for finance reconciliation. The ask is non-bug feature work for Console/Reporting.

Goals: 1) Define an MVP scope that satisfies three enterprise customers with minimal infra changes. 2) Create a prioritization rubric for customer impact vs engineering effort. 3) Produce a PRD and wireframes for Console team to estimate and plan.

MVP proposal (high level):
- Add a scheduled export job that produces daily CSVs containing: date, org_id, team_id, api_key_id, model, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, compute_cost_usd, storage_bytes. Exports delivered to customer S3 with ACL or to console download.
- New Console view "Cost by Team" with filters for date range, model, and environment (hosted/dedicated/private), and an export button.
- Backend aggregation job that rolls up raw events into daily aggregates to avoid scanning event logs for each export.

Trade-offs and constraints:
- Accurate compute_cost requires using existing pricing models and mapping to per-token billing; small rounding errors are acceptable for MVP but must be surfaced in docs.
- On-Prem/air-gapped deployments may require a local export sink and will increase delivery time by ~2 cycles.
- Full per-request traceability (token-by-token) is out of scope for MVP due to storage/cost implications; add as a stretch goal.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Patel), Console Eng Lead (Priya Mehta), Billing (Marco Ruiz), Security/Compliance (Elena Wang), Customer Success (Rohan Kapoor).

Acceptance criteria: see field below.
acceptance_criteria: Daily scheduled export job produces CSV files with required columns for at least two pilot customers
Console "Cost by Team" view is accessible to org admins and shows per-team breakdown for selected date range
Exported files are delivered to customer S3 buckets with configurable path/prefix or available as an immediate download in Console
Documentation explains known rounding/estimation methodology for compute_cost and links to pricing models
Pilot customers confirm the exported data meets basic accounting reconciliation needs (billing line items match within 2%)
